reader.requirement: The first KEY data-name-2 must name the OCCURS entry itself or an entry subordinate to it; each later data-name-2 must be subordinate to it (not the entry itself).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2002: from 2002 a data description entry clause operand (ODO data-name-1, SAME AS, OCCURS KEY, RENAMES) takes the groups above its subject as implicit qualifiers; below 2002 the whole scope's candidates are counted, so a name declared beside the subject and in another record must be qualified

Edition.Cite: only the SR3 message text of COBOL2353 (the candidate set's edition step is IdentifyRegionOperand's, via ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers); OccursKeyItemFault's Year<2002 arm is SR12's, not these rules'

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 the candidate set is the whole scope's and the survivor is then asked to lie in the table; from 2002 the table's subtree is the set (an unqualified key also declared outside the table is ambiguous at 85, accepted at 2002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1018 covers a qualified key; the subject as first key, the subject as a later key and a key outside the table are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: FOUND BBB / NOT FOUND 30 / ENT FOUND
probes.expected: ODO counter CNT OF GC OF CTLS (value 3, then 2) bounds the SEARCH ALL; KEY IS K OF ROW, K2 IN KG OF ROW and KEY IS ENT (the subject) resolve

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2353 ... 'OUTK' ... no data item so named is 'T' itself or subordinate to it (1985 VI.5.8.3 SR3)
probes.expected: a key outside the table is refused

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2353 ... only the FIRST key data-name may name the table entry itself (1985 VI.5.8.3 SR3)
probes.expected: a subsequent key naming the subject is refused

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2353 'K OF R1 OF T' ... no data item so named under the written qualifiers
probes.expected: a key with qualifiers out of hierarchy order names nothing

probes.printed: 85: exit 65 COBOL1639 OCCURS ASCENDING KEY IS data-name-2 of 'T' 'K' ... 2 declarations; --std 2002: exit 0
probes.expected: an unqualified key also declared in another record must be qualified at 85

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR3  the text is in SR3 (quoted: Subsequent specification of data-name-2 must be subordinate)

reader.notes: OccursKeyResolvePass refuses a key outside the table and a non-first key naming the subject with COBOL2353 citing 1985 VI.5.8.3 SR3, and accepts KEY IS ENT on ENT itself (SEARCH ALL then finds the element).

refuter.evidence: ok1.cob: ASCENDING KEY IS K DESCENDING KEY IS T (the subject in a later KEY phrase) -> COBOL2353 only the FIRST key data-name may name the table entry itself. ok3.cob: KEY IS C88 (a level-88 under the entry) and KEY IS K OF R1 (a key in another record) -> COBOL2353. ok2.cob: a first KEY naming the subject, qualified (U OF R1), accepted and SEARCH ALL finds it. cite: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR3  the text is in SR3.
